name: 75-inset-shorthand
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; min-height: 780px; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 16px; } .box { position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; color: #fff; line-height: 1.5; } .one { inset: 12px 30px; width: 108px; height: 44px; background: #336699; } .two { inset: 70px 44px 28px 150px; width: 118px; height: 50px; background: #7a4f35; } .right { inset: 140px 30px auto auto; width: 104px; height: 46px; background: #476b3f; } .four { inset: 220px 40px 0 160px; width: 110px; height: 46px; background: #6d456f; } .bottom { inset: auto auto 34px 40px; width: 124px; height: 48px; background: #8a5d22; }
html:
inset 两值
inset 四值
right 生效
top/left 优先
bottom 生效
